name: Light Rattlesnake 90
author: hssqrshi
description: Neon gradient 3d rounded violet button that starts animating on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, background-color changes from #c47dfb to #b46cea, transform becomes perspective(500px) rotateX(5deg), starts the glow animation (animating). On focus, the outline is removed, box-shadow becomes 0 0 0 4px #c47dfb.
